theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_fv_tangent_projection_continuousOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ x ∈ M, Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)) = m) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection) M ∧ ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → ContinuousOn (fun x => LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap)) M
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
